notes.title: Discussion with developer on Discord
notes.content:
[h1]Chat with developer[/h1]
If you have any questions or you would like to discuss about game, [url=https://discord.gg/RMnhdXk]join in Discord server[/url].
You can join at any time or if you prefer to wait for scheduled discussion, [u]set a reminder[/u] for this event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37769415/b5f4aaee5028de623bcbd715b73d31b2c2bb0f9e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Checkout demo[/h1]

Don't forget to test your smashing skills in demo version of upcoming game [u]Village Fest™: Digging[/u]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37769415/2977ff0bdacd22bbd9e53d9aee85eed97f9ce26d.gif[/img]


[h1]Info[/h1]

[u]Village Fest™: Digging[/u] is competitive game where goal is to collect as much gold as you can, be it by digging, looting or even stealing.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1302030/Village_Fest_Digging/
